about: Regression set: 30 documents written blind by an agent that never saw our format, plus variants. route: lab = Dr. Eva Brandl (Labor Kanalstraße, lab_result), rehab = Stefan Kern (Reha Waldblick, discharge_report), patient = Maria Beispiel herself (lab_result). Expected outcome of fhirmap.decide + parse (FILE only if the parse is fileable and prove() passes).
